column1: # Game profile of Super Mario 3D All-Stars (Switch, base game v0 = 1.0.0, no update), program 0: the launcher. Plays on the Mac
# A multi-program application: the launcher (program 0, this profile) starts Super Mario 64 (program 1, title ID base + 1, an N64 emulator on nn::jit), Super Mario Sunshine
# (program 2, 010049900F546002: NERD's Hagi on Vulkan) and Super Mario Galaxy (program 3, 32-bit ARM, which Apple silicon cannot run: its tile stays in the menu but cannot be
# started, patches.py) with oe::ExecuteProgram, handing each a 16-byte launch parameter (LanguageCode, two volume floats). The host hands the switch to whoever started it
# Nintendo's sead / agl / gsys with NintendoWare's layout library on NVN, SDK 9.5.1. RomFS: zstd-compressed SARC archives (.zs), the menu's backgrounds and the opening as
# H.264 MP4 movies through the SDK's movie library (subsdk0), which agl converts into a texture and corrects for gamma in place (the same-pass snapshot of nvn_mtl.m fb_prepare)
# the menu wraps its clears in conditional rendering (SetRenderEnableConditional): without evaluating it every frame is black
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk0 (NintendoSDK_movie), sdk
# The NPDM declares no system resource (META +0x14 = 0): main sets a heap with SetHeapSize, 2.93 GB of the 3.25 GB heap region. The other EPD / sead games' partition without
# virtual address memory (4 GB block = 256 MB in front + 256 MB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 3.25 GB heap region). Measured on the Mac at the menu (the title, every tile,
# a soundtrack): 550 MB resident, 362 MB of it GPU allocations
# 3,899 shaders: agl's and gsys's BAHS (sharcb) in Lib, BNSH in ShaderData and the layouts, and 40 in main
